name: playwright-js-bdd-tests

scripts.allure:generate-report:web:bash: npx allure generate allure-results/chromium allure-results/firefox allure-results/webkit --clean -o allure-report
scripts.allure:generate-report:mobile:bash: npx allure generate allure-results/android allure-results/ios --clean -o allure-report
scripts.allure:generate-report:api:bash: npx allure generate allure-results/soapapi allure-results/restapi --clean -o allure-report
scripts.allure:generate-report:perf:bash: npx allure generate allure-results/perf allure-results/perf --clean -o allure-report
scripts.debug:chromium:tags:bash: TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER='chromium' PARALLEL=1 npx cucumber-js --parallel 1 --require support/world.js --require steps --tags "$TAGS"
scripts.test:chromium:tags:bash: cross-env TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER=chromium npx cucumber-js -p chromium --require support/world.js --require steps --tags "$TAGS"
scripts.test:firefox:tags:bash: cross-env TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER=firefox npx cucumber-js -p firefox --require support/world.js --require steps --tags "$TAGS"
scripts.test:webkit:tags:bash: cross-env TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER=webkit npx cucumber-js -p webkit --require support/world.js --require steps --tags "$TAGS"
scripts.test:chromium:smoke:bash: TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER='chromium' npx cucumber-js -p chromium --require support/world.js --require steps --tags '@smoke-web'
scripts.test:firefox:smoke:bash: TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER='firefox' npx cucumber-js -p firefox --require support/world.js --require steps --tags '@smoke-web'
scripts.test:webkit:smoke:bash: TEST_LEVEL=web BROWSER='webkit' npx cucumber-js -p webkit --require support/world.js --require steps --tags '@smoke-web'
scripts.test:crossbrowser:smoke:bash: TEST_LEVEL=web HEADLESS=false npm-run-all allure:remove-results:bash --parallel test:chromium:smoke:bash test:firefox:smoke:bash test:webkit:smoke:bash
scripts.test:crossbrowser:smoke:headless:bash: TEST_LEVEL=web HEADLESS=true npm-run-all allure:remove-results:bash--parallel test:chromium:smoke:bash test:firefox:smoke:bash test:webkit:smoke:bash
scripts.test:android:tags:bash: cross-env TAGS=$TAG TEST_LEVEL=android npx cucumber-js -p android --parallel 1 --require steps --require support/world.js --tags "$TAG"
scripts.test:android:bash: TEST_LEVEL=android npx cucumber-js -p android --parallel 1 --require steps --require support/world.js --tags '@android'
scripts.test:ios:tags:bash: cross-env TAGS=$TAG TEST_LEVEL=ios npx cucumber-js -p ios --parallel 1 --require steps --require support/world.js --tags "$TAG"
scripts.test:ios:bash: TEST_LEVEL=ios npx cucumber-js -p ios --parallel 1 --require steps --require support/world.js --tags '@ios'
scripts.test:api:soap:tags:bash: TEST_LEVEL=soapapi API_TYPE=soapapi npx cucumber-js -p soapapi --require support/world.js --require steps --tags "$TAGS"
scripts.test:api:rest:tags:bash: TEST_LEVEL=restapi API_TYPE=restapi npx cucumber-js -p restapi --require support/world.js --require steps --tags "$TAGS"
scripts.test:mobile:from-js:args:bash: node support/mobile/run-mobile-tests.js open_allure=$OPEN_ALLURE clear_old_results=$CLEAR_OLD_RESULTS platform=$PLATFORM target_device=$TARGET_DEVICE device_profile_name=$DEVICE_PROFILE_NAME tag=$TAG
scripts.docker-remove-all:bash: npm run docker-remove-images:bash && npm run docker-remove-containers:bash && npm run docker-compose-down:bash
scripts.docker-compose-run-tests-args:bash: OPEN_ALLURE=false BROWSER=chromium HEADLESS=false TAG='@sign-in' npm run docker-compose-run-tests:bash
